name: Menu
description: A menu button and its menu, on the platform's own Popover API: `<Menu>` is the button's menu, and every `Menu.Sub` inside it is another popover nested in that one.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The trigger, handed the ref and props that wire it to the menu. It has to be a button.

props.name: children
props.description: The items: `Menu.Item`, `Menu.CheckboxItem`, `Menu.RadioGroup`, `Menu.Group`, `Menu.Separator`, `Menu.Sub`.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Leave it out and the menu owns it.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether it starts open, when the menu owns its own state.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires with the new state and why it changed — `'select'`, `'trigger'`, `'escape'`, `'outside-pointer'`, `'tab'` or `'imperative'`. A close cannot be refused: the browser has already done it by then.

props.name: label
props.description: The menu's accessible name. Left out, it takes its trigger's, which is what APG asks for.

props.name: labelledBy
props.description: Names the menu after an element already on the page, instead of `label`.

props.name: side
props.description: Which side of the trigger the menu sits on — `top`/`bottom` are the block axis, `start`/`end` the inline one, so a menu beside its trigger mirrors in a right-to-left page. Default `'bottom'`.

props.name: align
props.description: Which of the trigger's edges to line the menu up with along the other axis. Default `'start'`.

props.name: offset
props.description: The gap between trigger and menu, on the ÷4 spacing scale. Default 1 — 4px.

props.name: flip
props.description: Whether a side with no room may be swapped for its opposite. Default `true`.

props.name: matchWidth
props.description: Whether the menu is at least as wide as its trigger. Default `false` — a menu sizes to its content.

parts.name: Menu.Item
parts.description: One command in the menu. A `<button>`, so Enter and Space are the browser's.

props.name: children
props.description: The item's content.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: The item was chosen — by a press, or by Enter or Space, which the browser turns into one.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Focusable, announced, and not activatable. `aria-disabled` rather than the `disabled` attribute, because APG asks that a disabled item stay reachable: a keyboard user has to be able to find out it is there at all.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Whether choosing it closes the whole menu. Default `true`.

parts.name: Menu.CheckboxItem
parts.description: An item that carries a state of its own: `role="menuitemcheckbox"` and a tick.

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled checked state. Leave it out and the item owns it.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Whether it starts checked, when the item owns its own state.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Fires with the new state, and the press behind it.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Whether toggling it closes the menu. Default `false`, so several boxes can be ticked in one visit.

parts.name: Menu.RadioGroup
parts.description: A set of items of which one is chosen: `role="group"`, and `menuitemradio` inside it.

props.name: children
props.description: The radio items.

props.name: label
props.description: The group's heading. It names the group, so a screen reader reads the items as a set.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value — the `value` of whichever item is checked.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value checked to start with, when the group owns its own state.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the value chosen, and the press behind it.

parts.name: Menu.RadioItem
parts.description: One of a radio group's choices. Checked when its `value` is the group's.

props.name: value
props.description: What this item stands for, compared against the group's `value`.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Whether choosing it closes the menu. Default `false`, the way a checkbox item behaves.

parts.name: Menu.Group
parts.description: A titled section. The heading names the group through `aria-labelledby`, so the items inside are read as a set rather than as a run of unrelated commands.

props.name: children
props.description: The items in the section.

props.name: label
props.description: The section's heading. It names the group rather than standing alone: a heading nothing is labelled by is read as a stray line of text, which is why there is no separate label part.

parts.name: Menu.Separator
parts.description: The line between two sections. `role="separator"`, which a menu is allowed to own.

parts.name: Menu.Sub
parts.description: A submenu: an item that opens a menu of its own. The panel is declared beside its item, *inside* the menu it belongs to, which is what makes it a nested popover — so opening it leaves the parent menu open and a press inside it is a press inside the parent (measured in Chrome 152).

props.name: label
props.description: The item's own content — what the submenu is called.

props.name: children
props.description: The submenu's items.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Focusable, announced, and it opens nothing. `aria-disabled`, for the reason `Menu.Item` gives.

props.name: side
props.description: Which side of its item the submenu sits on. Default `'end'` — beside it, on the side the text runs towards.

props.name: align
props.description: Which of the item's edges to line the submenu up with. Default `'start'`.

props.name: offset
props.description: The gap between item and submenu, on the ÷4 spacing scale. Default 0 — a submenu abuts its menu.

props.name: flip
props.description: Whether a side with no room may be swapped for its opposite. Default `true`.

props.name: itemProps
props.description: Attributes for the item that opens it — the submenu's own go in `props`.

keyboard.action: On the trigger, opens the menu with the first item focused. On an item, chooses it. On a submenu's item, opens the submenu.
On the trigger, opens the menu at its first or last item. Inside, moves between items and wraps at the ends.
The first or the last item.
Opens the submenu of the item that has focus, and closes the submenu focus is in — the other way round in a right-to-left menu, which is APG's rule and the reading order's.
Closes the innermost menu and puts focus back on what opened it.
Closes the menu and moves focus on, as APG asks.
Typeahead: jumps to the item whose text starts with what was typed, and the same letter again cycles through the items starting with it.

a11y: `role="menu"` on the panel, named by `label`, `labelledBy` or its trigger; `menuitem`, `menuitemcheckbox` and `menuitemradio` on the items, with `aria-checked` on the last two, `role="group"` around a titled section and `role="separator"` between them.
The trigger carries `aria-haspopup="menu"`, `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`; a submenu's item carries the same three, which is what says it opens another menu.
A disabled item is `aria-disabled` and stays focusable, as APG asks — the `disabled` attribute would take it out of the keyboard's reach and silence it.
